THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STUDIO

STUDY 085
Brown Leather Vest & Mini Skirt
Rights check
Source: 24967.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black hair
and blunt bangs stands in a full-length pose against a
charcoal gray backdrop. She wears a cropped brown
leather vest with covered buttons over a black ribbed
turtleneck, with a matching brown leather mini skirt and
a gold square belt buckle. Sheer black tights and tall
brown pointed-toe leather boots. Her expression is
calm and direct. Even studio light with soft shadow.
Palette of cognac brown, charcoal, and black. Sleek
and tailored, in the style of a fall fashion lookbook.
Sleek, tailored, bold
WORKING NOTES
- The cognac leather and gold buckle are the focal points.
- Add 'head to toe' to keep the boots in frame.
Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to include the boots.
